stemMd: Which procedure helped make numerical measurements comparable across participants?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Using the same type of meter and pausing for the same duration at marked locations.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Combining source descriptions with numerical readings into one score.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Recording only on major roads in the afternoon.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Allowing each resident to choose any route and time.

explanationMd: The fixed pause duration, marked locations, and common meter type standardize how readings are collected. They reduce differences introduced by participants' methods.

distractorRationale.c: That describes the earlier survey rather than the pilot's standardization.
distractorRationale.d: The routes and four times were fixed.
